title: RXVY SPAWNERS
description: RXVYSpawners is a high-performance Java plugin that features virtual loot storage, intelligent spawner stacking, and an all-in-one management GUI for optimized mob farming. If you have any questions or need support join https://discord.gg/Xx8h2Th8qv
body:
RXVYSpawners | The Professional Spawner Core
RXVYSpawners is a high-performance Java plugin designed for rxvysmp.net but i made it so you guys can use it that optimizes mob farming by replacing traditional entity-heavy drops with a sleek, virtualized storage system. It features intelligent spawner stacking and an all-in-one GUI that allows players to collect items or sell their entire spawners's inventory with a single click.

If you have any questions or need support with the plugin, please join our official community Discord at https://discord.gg/Xx8h2Th8qv
